name: CASC CH-4 Rainbow
armament: Light guided air-to-ground missiles (AR-1 type) and small guided bombs on underwing pylons (game: off-map strike)
protection: Game: any calibre can damage it; 7.62x54R and 12.7 mm or anti-aircraft guns can bring it down; EW support assets can jam or force it down.
visual_notes: MQ-9-like layout: slim fuselage with a bulged nose, long straight high-aspect wing
V-tail with a small ventral fin, rear pusher propeller
notes: Added in Job 7 for cod (FARDC), whose CH-4 strike drones are a signature asset of the 2024-2026 Kivu fighting. Other real-world operators (Iraq, Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Algeria and others) are not listed because their faction files do not reference this id.
